age.evidence: We used adult, 8-week-old male and female C57BL/6 J mice

sex.evidence: For each of the 8 drugs, we tested 4 male and 4 female C57BL/6 J mice, totaling 64 animals

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed in groups with 2-5 mice per cage

day_night_flipped.evidence: operating on a normal 12 hr light-12 hr dark cycle (8:00 AM to 8:00 PM for light)

assays.assay_description: Mice were placed in a plastic cube (4"×4"×4") wrapped with a solenoid coil; head movements were detected via a magnetic ear tag, the induced voltage signal filtered (70-110 Hz) and peak-detected in MATLAB to count head-twitches over a 2-hour period after drug administration.

application_type.evidence: psilocybin (1 mg/kg, i.p.); 5-MeO-DMT (20 mg/kg, i.p.); 6-fluoro-DET (20 mg/kg, i.p.)

setup_restrain.evidence: the animal was put inside a plastic cube (4'×4'×4')

food_restriction.evidence: Standard short test; food not present in the cube during recording. Home cage food was ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard short test; water not present in the cube during recording. Home cage water was ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: total number of head twitches detected within a 2-hour period after drug administration

sample_size.evidence: 3 males and 3 females for each drug (n=6), except 4 males and 3 females for saline (n=7)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (1 mg/kg) and 5-MeO-DMT (20 mg/kg) elicited robust head-twitch responses relative to saline, whereas 6-fluoro-DET (20 mg/kg) was not statistically different from saline controls, supporting its use as a non-hallucinogenic tryptamine.
outcomes.statistics: Wilcoxon rank-sum test (two-sided): SAL vs. 5-MEO P=3×10⁻³; 6-F-DET vs. 5-MEO P=2×10⁻²; SAL vs. PSI P=3×10⁻³; 6-F-DET vs. PSI P=8×10⁻³
outcomes.evidence: unlike 1 mg/kg psilocybin and 20 mg/kg 5-MeO-DMT which elicited robust head-twitch responses, mice administered with 20 mg/kg 6-fluoro-DET were not statistically different from controls

B1_num_measures.evidence: total number of head twitches detected within a 2-hour period

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Time course of head-twitch response following the administration of 5-MeO-DMT, psilocybin, 6-fluoro-DET, or saline vehicle

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transitions, sequences, or microstructure analysis reported

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly listed as a non-ethological artificial behaviour

B5_social.evidence: Each mouse was recorded using one cube

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Voltage signal bandpass filtered (70-110 Hz) and processed for peak detection - signal-processing peak detection, not video-based behavioural classification

B8_multivariate.evidence: No multivariate analysis applied to HTR data

E2_shelter.evidence: Bare plastic cube; no shelter described

E3_bedding.evidence: Bare plastic cube; no bedding described

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described in cube

E6_spatial.evidence: Single plastic cube with no internal compartments

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse was recorded using one cube

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water reported inside cube during recording

D1_continuity.evidence: total number of head twitches detected within a 2-hour period after drug administration

D5_followup.evidence: Recording only within 2 h of dose; no ≥24 h follow-up

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay (head-twitch response) was scored. Light-sheet imaging of brain-wide c-Fos expression is a histological/anatomical readout, not a behavioural assay, and was excluded per rubric.
B2 scored Yes: Fig. 1b shows within-session time course of HTR, satisfying temporal dynamics within the 2-hour recording.

B7 scored 0: gpt-oss scored 1, but peak detection on a filtered voltage trace from a magnetic ear-tag sensor is signal processing, not a video-based behavioural classifier on the rubric's allow-list (DeepLabCut, MoSeq, B-SOiD, SimBA, etc.). Defaulted to 0 per 'when in doubt, score 0'.

Dosing block expanded to include all psychedelic/psychoactive compounds administered in the study (psilocybin, 5-MeO-DMT, 6-fluoro-DET, ketamine, MDMA); fluoxetine is an SSRI and excluded from the psychedelic list, though candidate glm included it.
Sample size for HTR assay reflects only the head-twitch cohort (n=25 across 4 drugs), not the 64-mouse c-Fos cohort.
Food/water restriction: scored 'during' per rubric default for standard short tests where food/water is not in the apparatus; home-cage access was ad libitum.
